dependencies.name: redscript
dependencies.role: Runtime hook/additive/replace mechanism for Project E3 controller behavior.
dependencies.evidence: The exact private 2.31.p2 reference contains @wrapMethod/@replaceMethod/@addMethod/@addField sources across HUD, quest, interaction, mappin, crosshair, weapon, hotkey and nameplate controllers. Public Project E3 2.31 distribution metadata labels redscript HARD REQUIRED.

dependencies.name: TweakXL
dependencies.role: Loads Project E3 YAML TweakDB record changes for nameplate policy, world/minimap mappin definitions and profiles, clamping, and interaction choice-icon mappings.
dependencies.evidence: The exact reference contains r6/tweaks/Project E3 - HUD/*.yaml records including UINameplate, MappinClampingSettings, WorldMappinUIProfile and ChoiceIcons mappings; current Project E3 distribution identifies TweakXL as required. Public Project E3 2.31 distribution metadata labels TweakXL HARD REQUIRED.

dependencies.name: Cyberpunk archive resource override
dependencies.role: Supplies the authored INK/resources that give Project E3 its actual widget hierarchy, styling, atlases, animations and related HUD assets.
dependencies.evidence: Direct inspection of Biology-Private-ReferenceBundle-20260919-001914-365937cf.zip verifies archive/pc/mod/basegame_3e_demo_hud.archive at 33,013,760 bytes and SHA-256 776556B6913C3B6B2FE1E13DA0964732FA917A130EA9C2A43E34AD4F5FEC03B6. Its WolvenKit listing contains 370 resource paths after excluding four WolvenKit long-path warning footer lines. The inventory directly includes quest_tracker.inkwidget, dpad_hint.inkwidget, compass.inkwidget, ammo_counter.inkwidget, playerhealthbar.inkwidget, npcnameplate.inkwidget, minimap.inkwidget, scanner_hud.inkwidget/scandetails.inkwidget/quickhacks.inkwidget, activity_log.inkwidget, and interaction/dialog resources.

dependencies.name: Mod Settings
dependencies.role: Optional settings-editor surface for ProjectE3HUDSettings only; not required for the underlying HUD hooks/resources.
dependencies.evidence: Exact reference ModSettings.reds consists of ModSettings runtime properties for compass/nameplate/mappin/crosshair options; current Project E3 distribution describes Mod Settings as optional. Public Project E3 2.31 distribution metadata says Mod Settings is not required for the mod to work and is used for customization.

conclusions: Project E3 2.31.p2 is a three-layer implementation: redscript controller logic, TweakXL/TweakDB policy records, and a large authored archive/resource layer. Its visual fidelity is not primarily explained by REDscript-created rectangles.

The Project E3 archive is architecturally material. Historical Biology round-trip evidence proves 370 resources; config/patches/realpass-modern-scanner.json preserves the exact 34 scanner/quickhack/focus/connected-device exclusions with per-resource SHA-256, while the other 336 E3 resources were retained byte-for-byte.

Biology intentionally does not copy that architecture wholesale. Whole stock-resource replacement and broad replaceMethod/TweakXL policy changes would expand patch/conflict surface compared with the narrower current native-content-region wrappers.
W03.5/W03.6 weapon, quest and hotkey semantic-host work remains architecturally sound: it uses current 2.31 native authority rather than Project E3's custom archive hierarchy.
Biology's ambient nameplate policy intentionally differs from Project E3: native hidden/alternative/quest/disabled policy remains authoritative, and actor level/health presentation is not imported.
Modern scanner/quickhack preservation is an explicit divergence from Project E3 and remains a hard boundary.

Future visual-fidelity work may use Biology-owned REDmod archive resources where a static authored INK resource is demonstrably safer/cleaner, but Project E3 resource bytes and implementation bodies must never become a runtime dependency or redistribution payload.

Direct inspection of Biology-Private-ReferenceBundle-20260919-001914-365937cf.zip closes the Project E3 archive gate independently of parent summaries: the exact pinned archive lists 370 resource paths, and the Project E3 source hard-targets authored child hierarchies that correspond to those archive resource families.

The bundle does not serialize the Project E3 INK trees to JSON, but no further owner probe is needed for W18.1: hard-coded Project E3 widget paths plus the verified exact archive resource inventory are sufficient to distinguish authored resource composition from runtime-created geometry.

No additional W18 runtime source correction is warranted before T005: W03.5/W03.6 already moved Biology onto live-proven current-2.31 semantic hosts. Existing generated chrome is accent-only; any future structural fidelity correction must use a Biology-owned REDmod/INK resource authored from scratch rather than more guessed runtime geometry.
